description: This file contains the implementation of the Hibernate-based data access object (DAO) for handling Condition entities within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, and delete condition records associated with patients and encounters.

classes.name: HibernateConditionDAO
classes.description: Implements data access methods for Condition objects using Hibernate ORM, including retrieval by ID or UUID, querying by encounter or patient, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: getCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its database ID.

methods.name: getConditionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Condition by its UUID.

methods.name: getConditionsByEncounter
methods.description: Fetches all Condition records associated with a specific encounter, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: getActiveConditions
methods.description: Retrieves all active (non-voided) conditions for a given patient, filtering by clinical status.

methods.name: getAllConditions
methods.description: Retrieves all non-voided conditions for a given patient.

methods.name: deleteCondition
methods.description: Deletes a specified condition record from the database.

methods.name: saveCondition
methods.description: Saves or updates a Condition in the database.
